deescalation_model_escalated: I beg your pardon. I should have known better, and I ask you to forgive my last outburst.
I spoke too warmly, and there was no offence meant on your side.
I took offence where none was intended; the fault is mine.
Forgive my heat, sir. I mistook your meaning for an affront.
I was hasty, and I am sorry for it. Let us go on civilly.
